title: A New World Space can wear the Profile Spotlight look, and the console preview draws the same page as the public link

source.ref: Daniel 2026-11-06: the danieltyack Spotlight editor preview showed the old generic card page while the live page showed a broken New World stack (no photo, no About, no contact form).

detail: spaces.preferences.spotlight.look = 'profile' on a New World Space draws the design's Profile layout from the Space's own profile photo, header image, tagline and links (frequencylocal.com is the big button, the rest sit under it), then About, Contact form and the closing Button. The public page and the console preview share NewWorldProfileSpotlight. No migration; danieltyack's look is set by a one-off data write.

verify.evidence: Open /spaces/danieltyack/spotlight and /spaces/danieltyack/manage/spotlight: same portrait, header image, primary link, links and contact form.
